blurb: a plain-html public ledger for the receipts, the potholes, whatever else a community wants on the record — link the scanned original, no login to browse, and repeat pothole reports on the same spot tally up instead of disappearing. off a thread by @howard-beale.fromthewestmeadow.com daring someone to build it; @fromthewestmeadow.com tagged the bot.
